name: a-to-z-fitness-os
description: Gym management platform for A to Z Fitness, Mehdipatnam, Hyderabad

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@azf/shared && npm run build --workspace=@azf/api && npm run build --workspace=@azf/web

overridesRationale.deepmerge-ts: GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx (stack exhaustion, <8.0.0). Reaches us only via the Prisma CLI's config loader, which parses schema.prisma at build time and never sees request input. Pinned to the patched line so we keep stable Prisma 7 instead of moving to an 8.x release candidate under a payments system.
overridesRationale.@types/react: The app runs React 18, but transitive dependencies pull @types/react@19 which hoists above our ^18 spec. Two copies in the tree make every lucide-react icon and every Radix component fail to typecheck as a JSX element, because React 19 widened ReactNode to include bigint. Pinned to 18.x so one copy exists.
